plays.title: This is Money 24
plays.text: It turns a trade idea into a full plan and trades it on paper. It is a work in progress. What you see is a snapshot recorded {when}: nothing here is live.
plays.textPending: It turns a trade idea into a full plan and trades it on paper. It is a work in progress. What you see is a recorded snapshot: nothing here is live.

plays.title: The plays
plays.text: Every play, with what has to happen for it to pay. Pick one.

plays.title: The stake dial
plays.text: Drag the stake. Every number on the play follows it.

plays.title: Four pages
plays.text: Plays, Markets, News and Wallet. The journal lives under Plays. Each page has a short tour like this.

desk.title: Callouts
desk.text: Trade callouts come in here. The demo only reads; your own runner paper trades them.

desk.title: Sources
desk.text: Who the runner listens to: callers, option flow, news and leaderboards.

markets.title: Search
markets.text: Six symbols were recorded. Try SPY or BTC-USD.

markets.title: Ranges
markets.text: One day to all time. The chart redraws from the recording.

news.title: Three views
news.text: News, Calendar and Network. The calendar holds earnings, auctions and economic releases.
